items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Trumpets - Dud Bascomb, Marcellus Green, and myself.

ctx.x: Trumpets - Dud Bascomb, Marcellus Green, and myself. Bob Range and Edward Sims were trombone. Tracy, I can't remember the first name, and Jimmy Mitchelle, Richard Sanford. That's one, two three. That's three of them on sax. I've got one other one. It'll come to me in a minute. Oh, that's right. (Unclear) When we got there, Haywood joined us. That made the fourth sax. And then, later Julian Dash came in and made the five. Then, after that, Sammy Lowe was sent back and he came in. And then later on, Tracy went out…
